issues.legal_issue: A creditor enforcing a composite decree that makes a guarantor personally liable and secures part of the debt by mortgage must proceed against the mortgaged property before executing against the guarantor.
material_facts: The bank obtained a composite decree against the principal debtor and guarantors, making them personally liable and declaring part of the debt recoverable under a mortgage.
The bank sought execution against the guarantor, and the execution court and High Court required the bank to proceed first against the mortgaged property and the principal debtor.
The bank relied on the guarantor’s independent undertaking and on an earlier decision concerning execution against a surety.
issues.conclusion: The Court held that, because part of the decreed amount was covered by the mortgage, the bank had to proceed against the mortgaged property before executing against the guarantor. The High Court was not shown that these steps had been taken, so its direction was not shown to be erroneous on the record before it.
issues.legal_principle: In Bank of Bihar Ltd. v. Damodar Prasad, the Court held that, absent special equity, a surety ordinarily cannot restrain execution against the surety until remedies against the principal debtor have been exhausted. That general rule did not displace the requirement applied here: where a composite decree secures part of the debt by mortgage, the decree-holder must first proceed against the mortgaged property before proceeding against the guarantor.

predicates.execution_of_composite_decree: A creditor seeks to enforce a decree that imposes personal liability and also grants relief against property securing the debt.
predicates.debt_partly_secured_by_mortgage: Part of the debt covered by the decree is secured by mortgaged property.
predicates.mortgaged_property_must_be_pursued_befor: The creditor must proceed against the mortgaged property before seeking execution against the guarantor.

issues.definition: When execution concerns a decree imposing personal liability and mortgage relief for a debt partly secured by property, the property must be pursued before the guarantor.

issues.legal_issue: Execution against a guarantor is maintainable after the decree-holder has proceeded against both the mortgaged property and the principal debtor, if those steps were in fact taken.
material_facts: In its statement of facts in the special leave petition, the bank said it had applied for sale of the mortgaged property but received no purchase offer, and had also filed an execution application against the principal debtor.
The Court had not been told in the High Court that these steps had been taken.
The guarantor was given liberty to dispute whether the bank’s statement was correct.
issues.conclusion: If the bank’s statement that it had proceeded against the mortgaged property and the principal debtor was correct, execution against the guarantor was maintainable. The Court remanded the matter to the High Court so the bank could advance that case and the guarantor could dispute it.
issues.legal_principle: Applying the requirement that a decree-holder first proceed against the mortgaged property in a composite decree, the Court stated that execution against the guarantor would be maintainable if the decree-holder had proceeded against both the mortgaged property and the principal debtor. It relied on Bank of Bihar Ltd. v. Damodar Prasad for the general rule that a surety ordinarily cannot require the creditor to exhaust remedies against the principal debtor first, but resolved this case in light of the mortgage component and the disputed claim that prior steps had been taken.

rule.if: execution_of_composite_decree and debt_partly_secured_by_mortgage and mortgaged_property_pursued and principal_debtor_pursued

predicates.debt_partly_secured_by_mortgage: Part of the debt covered by the decree is secured by mortgaged property.
predicates.mortgaged_property_pursued: The creditor has taken steps to proceed against the mortgaged property.
predicates.principal_debtor_pursued: The creditor has taken steps to proceed against the principal debtor.
predicates.execution_against_guarantor_is_maintaina: The creditor may execute the decree against the guarantor.
